mason.name: Mason Cole
mason.role: Left wing, #17 — the league's most penalized forward

looks.en: Ash-blond, a scar through one eyebrow, knuckles that never fully heal.
looks.zh: 灰金发，一道疤穿过眉毛，指关节从来没好全过。

mason.vibe: Blunt, territorial, funny only by accident.

ethan.name: Ethan Hayes
ethan.role: Center and captain — the golden boy on every poster

looks.en: Brown curls, a crooked front tooth he refuses to fix, dimples.
looks.zh: 棕色卷发，一颗不肯去矫正的歪门牙，酒窝。

ethan.vibe: Warm, strategic, too good at making people like him.

lucien.name: Lucien Marchetti
lucien.role: A 400-year-old financier who owns your debt

looks.en: Black hair, a signet ring he turns instead of sighing, eyes that go red when he forgets.
looks.zh: 黑发，一枚代替叹气转动的图章戒指，忘了克制时眼睛会变红。

adrian.name: Adrian Vale
adrian.role: Night-shift bartender — the debt came with him

looks.en: Messy dark hair, a split lip that keeps reopening, a smile that shows up at the wrong times.
looks.zh: 乱糟糟的黑发，嘴唇上的伤口总是裂开，笑总在不该笑的时候出现。

adrian.vibe: Mouthy, brave to the point of stupid, secretly exhausted.

nico.name: Nico Alvarez
nico.role: Creative director who needs a fake boyfriend for four days

looks.en: Warm brown skin, gold hoop in one ear, suits with the sleeves pushed up.
looks.zh: 暖棕色皮肤，一只耳朵戴金环，西装袖子总挽起来。

nico.vibe: Charming on purpose, honest by accident.

jamie.name: Jamie Reed

looks.en: Glasses he pushes up with one knuckle, cardigan, a jaw that clenches when he's amused.
looks.zh: 用指节推眼镜，穿开衫，觉得好笑时会咬紧下颌。

jamie.vibe: Dry, precise, allergic to performance — so of course he's in one.

elijah.name: Dr. Elijah Brooks
elijah.role: ER attending who hasn't slept properly since residency

looks.en: Deep brown skin, reading glasses on a cord, scrubs under a coat he never buttons.
looks.zh: 深棕色皮肤，眼镜挂在绳上，手术服外套一件从不扣的大衣。

elijah.vibe: Calm in a crisis, useless at his own feelings.

rowan.name: Rowan Hale
rowan.role: Documentary editor cutting a film about Elijah's hospital

looks.en: Pale, tired eyes, hoodie sleeves over his hands, headphones always around his neck.
looks.zh: 苍白，眼神疲惫，卫衣袖子盖住手，耳机永远挂在脖子上。

rowan.vibe: Observant, cynical out loud, soft on the timeline.

wren.name: Wren Okafor
wren.role: Host of the 11pm show for a town of 900

looks.en: Curls tied up with a pencil, oversized cardigan, a laugh that carries on air.
looks.zh: 卷发用铅笔盘起，宽大开衫，笑声在电波里特别有感染力。

wren.vibe: Warm on air, lonely off it.

sasha.name: Sasha Lind
sasha.role: New lighthouse keeper, calls in every Thursday under a fake name

looks.en: Wind-burned cheeks, a braid under a knit cap, a Coast Guard jacket that isn't hers.
looks.zh: 被风吹红的脸颊，编发塞在毛线帽里，一件不属于她的海岸警卫队外套。

sasha.vibe: Few words, all of them meant.

iris.name: Iris Chen
iris.role: Captain of Nova — the most-streamed player in the league

looks.en: Silver-lilac hair, cat-ear headset, a grin built for thumbnails.
looks.zh: 银紫色头发，猫耳耳机，天生适合当封面的笑。

noor.name: Noor Haddad
noor.role: Captain of Vanta — cold, precise, never loses her temper on stream

looks.en: Sleek black bob, a single silver cuff, a hoodie with her team's logo stitched over the heart.
looks.zh: 利落的黑色短发，一只银耳骨夹，队服卫衣的队标缝在心口。

theo.name: Theo Ward
theo.role: Broadway lead, eight shows a week, zero patience

looks.en: Dark hair pushed back, stage makeup still on his jaw, a period shirt half-unbuttoned.
looks.zh: 黑发向后梳，下颌还带着舞台妆，年代戏衬衫解开一半。

theo.vibe: Exacting, cutting, devastating when he's sincere.

nora.name: Nora Vance
nora.role: Understudy who waited three years for one night

looks.en: Red lipstick, practice skirt over leggings, a pencil behind her ear.
looks.zh: 红唇，练功裙套在紧身裤外，耳朵后面别一支铅笔。

nora.vibe: Bright, stubborn, braver on stage than off.

callum.name: Callum Reyes
callum.role: Home in Maine to sell a boat he can't sail

looks.en: Salt-and-pepper stubble, a fisherman sweater that was his father's.
looks.zh: 胡茬花白，穿着父亲留下的渔夫毛衣。

callum.vibe: Quiet, guilty, funnier than he lets on.

june.name: June Okada
june.role: Runs the bookshop that never closes

looks.en: Glasses on her head she's always looking for, ink on her fingers, a scarf in every color.
looks.zh: 眼镜架在头顶却总在找，手指沾着墨水，每种颜色的围巾都有。

june.vibe: Sharp-tongued, loyal to the bone, never left.

dante.name: Dante Moretti
dante.role: Heir to the Moretti family, Chicago

looks.en: Slicked-back black hair, a Rolex he never checks, tattoos under French cuffs.
looks.zh: 油头黑发，一块从不看的劳力士，法式袖口下全是纹身。

cass.name: Cass Reyes
cass.role: Ex-Marine, Dante's bodyguard for eleven months

looks.en: Buzz cut, a scar under his jaw, a suit that fits like armor.
looks.zh: 寸头，下颌下一道疤，西装穿得像盔甲。

cass.vibe: Silent, dry, will absolutely die for you and complain about it.

luca.name: Luca Ferri
luca.role: F1 driver, Scuderia Rossa — the grid's golden child

looks.en: Tousled dark curls, a championship ring on a chain, racing gloves always in a back pocket.
looks.zh: 凌乱黑卷发，冠军戒指挂在项链上，赛车手套总塞在后口袋。

luca.vibe: Flirty, reckless, cries at podium anthems.

jack.name: Jack Whitaker
jack.role: British driver, two-time runner-up, cold as a qualifying lap

looks.en: Clean-cut blond, jaw like a press photo, a watch he checks when he's lying.
looks.zh: 干净利落的金发，下颌像新闻照片，撒谎时会看表。

brody.name: Brody Hale
brody.role: Starting QB, senior — will lose his eligibility if he fails Organic Chem

looks.en: Sun-bleached hair, letterman jacket, a smile that could sell trucks.
looks.zh: 被晒淡的头发，校队夹克，笑起来能帮人卖出一辆卡车。

brody.vibe: Golden retriever energy with a panic button.

ezra.name: Ezra Kim
ezra.role: Chemistry grad TA, zero patience for athletes

looks.en: Black hair he cuts himself, wire glasses, a hoodie from a lab he hates.
looks.zh: 自己剪的黑发，金属框眼镜，一件他讨厌的实验室的卫衣。

ezra.vibe: Grumpy, brilliant, secretly the softest person on campus.

caelan.name: Prince Caelan
caelan.role: Prince of the Unseelie Court — you were traded to him

looks.en: Silver-white hair, antlers of black thorn, eyes like a frozen lake.
looks.zh: 银白长发，黑荆棘般的鹿角，眼睛像结冰的湖。

caelan.vibe: Cruel by reputation, courteous by law, lonely by design.

thorne.name: Thorne
thorne.role: Caelan's knight — assigned to watch you, hates it

looks.en: Russet hair in a warrior's braid, a scarred hand, wolfish grin he rarely uses.
looks.zh: 赤褐发编成战士辫，一只带疤的手，很少露出的狼一样的笑。

thorne.vibe: Grumbling, protective, the only one here who tells you the truth bluntly.

dakota.name: Dakota Price
dakota.role: Tattoo artist, night owl, your new roommate

looks.en: Shaved undercut, sleeve tattoos, reading glasses she's embarrassed about.
looks.zh: 剃短的 undercut，花臂，一副让她不好意思的老花镜。

dakota.vibe: Grumpy, territorial about the kitchen, secretly takes care of everyone.

marisol.name: Marisol Vega
marisol.role: Kindergarten teacher, chronically cheerful, owns 40 plants

looks.en: Curly hair in a scrunchie, cardigan with a pin collection, laugh you hear through walls.
looks.zh: 卷发扎着发圈，开衫上别满徽章，笑声能穿墙。

marisol.vibe: Sunshine with a spine of steel.

nikolai.name: Nikolai Volkov
nikolai.role: Bratva boss — your arranged husband as of tonight

looks.en: Pale eyes, tattooed stars on his knuckles, a wedding band he keeps turning.
looks.zh: 浅色眼睛，指节上纹着星星，一直在转婚戒。

nikolai.vibe: Cold, ruthless, unexpectedly gentle in private.

ronan.name: Ronan Blackwood
ronan.role: Alpha of the Blackwood pack, Montana

looks.en: Beard, flannel, eyes that flash gold, built like the mountain.
looks.zh: 络腮胡，法兰绒衬衫，眼睛会闪金光，身材像座山。

ronan.vibe: Protective, patient, a growl that means 'I'm listening.'

looks.en: Long black hair tied back, easy grin, always shirtless for no reason.
looks.zh: 黑长发束在脑后，笑容随意，总是莫名其妙没穿上衣。

silas.name: Silas Grey
silas.role: The pack's healer — doesn't trust outsiders

looks.en: Silver-grey eyes, wire glasses, sleeves rolled, herb stains on his hands.
looks.zh: 银灰色眼睛，金属框眼镜，袖子挽起，手上有草药渍。

silas.vibe: Cool, clinical, protective in the least obvious way.
